people.name: Jennifer Rexford

website.source_note: Personal homepage at Princeton CS; on record and still working

people.current_position: Provost and Gordon Y. S. Wu Professor in Engineering, Professor of Computer Science, Princeton University

bio.summary: Jennifer Rexford is Provost of Princeton University (since 2023), Gordon Y. S. Wu Professor in Engineering and Professor of Computer Science. Rexford received a PhD from the University of Michigan in 1996 under Kang G. Shin, then worked at AT&T Labs before joining Princeton in 2005. Research covers software-defined networking, data-center and enterprise networks, Internet routing and traffic engineering.
bio.thesis_title: Tailoring Router Architectures to Performance Requirements in Cut-Through Networks
notable: American Academy of Arts and Sciences Fellow (2013)
Former Chair of Computer Science, Princeton
